player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id} ngesiJalimane Whist. {phase_info} Unamakhadi {hand_size}. Dlala ikhadi elino-'[play N]', lapho u-N eyisikhundla salo esandleni sakho (isibonelo '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Ayikho ikhadi elinikezwayo - isigaba sokudlala sesiqalile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokunyakaza engalungile. Sebenzisa u-'[play N]' ukudlala ikhadi le-Nth esandleni sakho.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Kumelwe wenze okufanayo futhi udlale ikhadi elithi {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Umdlali {winner_id} uwina iqhinga nge {card} futhi uthatha ikhadi elibheke phezulu.

phase.learning_complete: Umthwalo usuphelile. Isigaba sokufunda sesiphelile - wonke amaqhinga asele ayabaluleka ukuze sinqobe.

draw.loser_received: Ulahlekelwe inkohliso futhi wadonsa u- {card} emgodini.

turn.scores_learning: Amasu awine kuze kube manje - Umdlali 0: {tricks0}, Umdlali 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Ayikho amakhadi adlalwa okwamanje leli qhinga.

board_str.player_line: {observation} Umdlali {player_id}: {scoring} amagoli okufaka amaphuzu ({tricks} isiyonke), {hand_size} amakhadi esandleni

outcome.summary: Isigaba sokufunda - Umdlali 0: {l0}, Umdlali 1: {l1}. Isigaba sokudlala - Umdlali 0: {p0}, Umdlali 1: {p1}. Umdlali {winner_id} uyaphumelela ngamaqhinga wokushaya amagoli {winner_tricks}!
